artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: mezzotint and etching printed in green ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 30.8 × 43.3 cm (12 1/8 × 17 1/16 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape view from an elevated position, showing hills, mountains, trees, and classical buildings on the horizon. The engraving technique creates detailed textures in the foliage and terrain, with a color palette of greenish blacks and grays. Two figures are depicted near trees in the foreground, with another two near a river in the distance.

artworks.title: Heroic Stormy Landscape
artworks.artist: Elisha Kirkall, after Jan van Huysum
artworks.medium: mezzotint and etching printed in blue and brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 29.9 × 39.3 cm (11 3/4 × 15 1/2 in.)
sheet: 31.6 × 39.3 cm (12 7/16 × 15 1/2 in.) (trimmed to plate mark on three sides)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed landscape with human activity. The scene includes a mountain range, clouds, a small bridge, and architectural structures. The brushstrokes are intricate, creating a classical etched appearance. The color palette is dominated by earthy sienna tones with subtle blues in the sky. A group of figures is shown in action near trees and a monument, with a pedestal in the center featuring a portrait relief.

artworks.title: View of Steyr on Enns
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a detailed medieval town with rolling hills and distant mountains. The town consists of closely packed buildings with steep roofs and walls, a church spire, and a bridge over a waterway. A large tree trunk with branches is depicted on the right side. The style is characterized by fine-line work typical of engravings in a monochrome color palette.

artworks.title: Abraham Casting Out Hagar
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving portraying a scene from a raised perspective. Various elements like leafy plants, a ladder, farm equipment, two figures in historical attire, a wooden house with a thatched roof, birds in flight, and silhouettes of structures and trees are depicted in rich detail. The use of intricate lines and shading creates texture and depth in the grayscale composition.

artworks.title: The Fall of Man
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 28.5 x 38.1 cm (11 1/4 x 15 in.) (trimmed within plate mark)
artworks.description: The image shows two naked figures, a man and a woman, both fully visible. The man stands on the left while the woman stands on the right. The man has curly hair and a muscular build. The woman has long wavy hair falling over her shoulders. The man is holding a leaf covering his groin and the woman is holding a fruit. Both figures are near a tree with a serpent coiled around it above their heads. Surrounding them on the ground are foliage and various animals including a snake, a lion, goats, and a dog lying beside a sheep. The background includes more animals, trees, and hills, depicted in detail.

artworks.title: The Four Elements
artworks.artist: attributed to Jacob Matham, after Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four mythological figures amidst clouds and plants. The upper part of the image depicts two floating figures, one holding a bird while the other wields a sword and is accompanied by a mythical creature. The lower portion of the drawing features two individuals; one is seated, partially shown from the back with detailed headgear, and the other reclines while holding a stalk of wheat or grain. The background is laden with swirling clouds and stylized foliage. The intricate details in the figures' musculature, flowing lines, and organic textures augment the contrast in the use of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Portrait of Hendrick Goltzius
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 57.1 × 43 cm (22 1/2 × 16 15/16 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait of an elderly man shown from the chest up, positioned in a slightly turned pose towards the right. The man's facial features include deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a full beard and mustache. His hair appears combed back and is mostly covered by a cap. He wears a garment with a large ruff around his neck, and a fur piece draped over his clothing. The background features an arched design with intricate patterns, a classical bust in the top left corner, and illustrations of torches and what appears to be a crossed trumpet on the right side. The engraving includes the name "HENDRICK GOLTZIUS" below the portrait, written in a stylized font with decorative elements.

artworks.title: The Seven Virtues
artworks.artist: attributed to Jacob Matham, after Hendrik Goltzius
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various mythological figures and symbols. The image features a collection of figures, including both female and male characters, depicted in a classical style. In the foreground, a seated figure holds a snake and a mirror, while another holds a column. In the center, a female figure holds a sword and scales. In the background, detailed scenery with trees and mountains provides context and setting.

artworks.title: Venus and Cupid
artworks.artist: attributed to Jacob Matham, after Hendrick Goltzius

artworks.title: Landscape with Shepherds
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, animals, and a figure in a pastoral setting. The horizon is low, emphasizing tall, detailed trees. The etching technique used highlights the intricacy of the trees' forms. The color palette is sepia and black, creating a classic look. Sheep are near the viewer, grazing on a textured surface. A figure, likely a shepherd, is in the scene. More trees extend into the distance, adding depth. In the background, there are softer, less detailed strokes hinting at more trees and possibly a path.

artworks.title: A Night Robbery
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 32.3 × 43 cm (12 11/16 × 16 15/16 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: The image shows a head-on view of a rocky landscape at night under a glowing moon. The horizon is not clearly defined, focusing instead on the textures of the rocks and trees. Animals are gathered around figures, likely shepherds. The artwork uses detailed cross-hatching and stippling to depict shadows and textures. The color palette is monochromatic, with black, white, and grey contrasting the moonlit night setting. The artwork includes brushstrokes and etchings to represent trees and shadows on the rocks. The moon is prominently featured in the upper right corner, illuminating the scene.

artworks.title: Arion on a Dolphin
artworks.artist: Jan Muller, after Cornelis Cornelisz van Haarlem
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 35.3 x 35.4 cm (13 7/8 x 13 15/16 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a figure seated on a large fish with a harp, surrounded by a turbulent sea. The central figure is detailed, with muscular features and a billowing cloak. The figure holds a harp in their left arm and gazes upwards. The waves around them are vigorous, conveying a stormy sea. In the background, a ship battles the waves. The artwork showcases detailed lines and crosshatching techniques, creating texture and depth.

artworks.title: Bellona Leading the Imperial Armies Against the Turks
artworks.description: This is a painting of a warrior woman in battle. The central figure is an armored female warrior standing against a backdrop of a turbulent sky and battlefield. She holds a horn to her lips. Her attire is ornate with flowing garments and distinct armor pieces. To her sides, numerous weapons, shields, and banners are visible. The background contains a detailed landscape with armed figures in battle. The painting is in the style of Peter Paul Rubens.

artworks.title: Fortune Distributing her Gifts
artworks.artist: Jan Muller, after Cornelis Cornelisz van Haarlem
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 50.6 × 91.1 cm (19 15/16 × 35 7/8 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple nude figures surrounding a central figure on a pedestal. The figures are muscular and contorted in various poses. In the center, a figure stands raised on the pedestal, reaching an arm upwards. The other figures are engaged in dramatic gestures, some pointing towards the central figure while others avert their gaze or appear in action or struggle. Strong contrasts between light and shadow highlight the muscularity and intensity of each figure's form. The scene conveys an atmosphere of a grand narrative or mythological theme.

artworks.title: Cain Killing Abel
artworks.artist: Jan Muller, after Cornelis Cornelisz van Haarlem
artworks.description: The image displays two nude males in a physical altercation. One figure stands, gripping the other's hair with one hand and raising his other arm. The other man is sprawled on the ground, slightly propped up on one arm with bent legs. Both have curly hair and distinct facial features, though expressions are unclear. The background features a natural landscape with trees, hills, swirling clouds in the sky, and two smaller figures walking along a path in the distance.

artworks.title: Cupid and Psyche
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures in a classical setting. In the center, a reclining nude woman lies on a draped bed. A cherub-like child stands to her left, holding a piece of drapery. Another cherub flies above, holding fabric. On the right stands a winged male figure holding a bow. In the foreground, a small putto holds an arrow. The background features detailed drapery, columns, and an ornamental piece, creating a rich classical environment.

artworks.title: Hagar in the Desert Consoled by an Angel
artworks.description: The image shows two human figures in the foreground. One figure is seated against a tree trunk, wearing draped fabric with curly hair. The other figure stands leaning towards the seated one, with visible wings. Both figures have curly hair and are dressed in flowing garments. They are surrounded by a natural setting with trees, and in the background, there are mountains and water visible. In the foreground, there are objects like a bundle and vessels on the ground.

artworks.title: Cleopatra
artworks.artist: Jan Muller, after Adriaen de Vries
artworks.description: The image shows a seated individual on a draped platform. The person is sitting with a slightly leaning back posture, gazing upwards with their mouth open. Their facial features are detailed, showcasing heavy eyelids and curly hair. The person appears unclothed, with partial drapery over their lower body. They are holding a snake in each hand, one coiled around the left arm and across the torso, while the other is draped across the right leg. The background features heavy drapery and various objects around the figure.

artworks.title: The Apotheosis of the Arts
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 68.1 × 50.4 cm (26 13/16 × 19 13/16 in.) (trimmed to plate mark)
artworks.description: This image depicts mythological figures in a celestial setting. The figures are on swirling clouds and are detailed with emphasis on anatomy and movement. The background includes an architectural structure, a distant landscape, and additional figures. The drawing is detailed and dramatic, resembling classical mythology illustrations.

artworks.title: Lot and His Daughters
artworks.description: The image shows three people portrayed in an ancient or mythological style in a seated position. The central figure is partially reclined against an older figure. To the right, a woman is pouring liquid from a jug into a bowl. The figures are draped in classical garments. In the foreground, there is a basket overflowing with fruit. The background features rocky textures resembling a cave or grotto, with a fabric draped above.

artworks.title: Minerva and Mercury Arming Perseus
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in various poses. In the foreground, a man stands with his back to the viewer, facing a woman on his right. He wears a lion's head pelt as a helmet and a draped garment, while the woman holds a mirrored shield and wears a flowing garment. A bare figure kneels to the left, holding ropes. To the right, a child holds a serpent and a sword. More figures are seen in the background, sitting on rocks. The landscape includes hills, trees, and riders on horses in the distance, framed by leafy trees.

artworks.title: Prudence
artworks.artist: Jan Muller, after Adriaen de Vries
artworks.description: The image shows a figure depicted from the back. The person is standing on one leg, with the other bent, while holding a mirror up to their face with their right hand. Their head is turned slightly to the right. The person is nude, with a fabric draped over their left arm and hanging down toward the ground. In the background, there is a mountainous landscape and rocky terrain. The foreground features a patterned ground surface.

artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus
artworks.description: This is a painting of a biblical scene. The image shows a central figure surrounded by other figures engaged in interactions. There are architectural elements like columns and decorative arches, along with trees and foliage in the background. Rich shading and detailed musculature enhance the drama of the scene. The painting showcases a play of light and shadow, emphasizing the emotional expressions of the figures. This is in the style of Peter Paul Rubens.

artworks.title: The Rape of a Sabine Woman (View from Behind)
artworks.artist: Jan Muller, after Adriaen de Vries
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two muscular figures standing in a dynamic pose. It features two human figures shown from the back, showcasing their muscular forms in intricate detail. One figure extends an arm outward while the other is reaching downward. The background includes a faded landscape with architectural elements and small figures. Fine lines are used for shading to emphasize the muscular definition and add depth to the composition.
